
# Turcu Fineas | Finimus

> Personal website of Turcu Fineas, known online as Finimus. A tech enthusiast interested in technology, artificial intelligence, computer systems, and digital projects.

## About

Turcu Fineas is a technology enthusiast who enjoys exploring, experimenting, and turning ideas into things that work. His approach focuses on learning by building, breaking, and understanding how things work.
